condition: On Windows with Python 3.15 and a NumPy 2.4.6 built from source with MinGW (an experimental build), safe_sort crashes with an access violation inside argsort, which MultiIndex.from_product and set_index both reach.
workaround: Install a NumPy wheel that supports Python 3.15 (NumPy 2.5.2 or later) instead of building NumPy 2.4.6 from source with MinGW.
